    [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S j) (T i j)]

    [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (g i * g j) (T i j)]
    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)

    ∃ F₁ : DivFamZarAff C R n,

  rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlg_comp, DivFamZarAff.mapAlg_comp]

end
end AlgebraicGeometry

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

open CategoryTheory

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
variable {ι : Type u} (g : ι → R) (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)]
  [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)] [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)]
  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
variable [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (S i))]
variable (E : ∀ i, CertifiedDivisorFamily C (S i) π n)
variable (T : ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra k (T i j)]
  [∀ i j, Algebra R (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k R (T i j)]
  [∀ i j, Algebra (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra (S j) (T i j)]
  [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower k (S j) (T i j)]
  [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S i) (T i j)] [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (S j) (T i j)]
  [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (g i * g j) (T i j)]

/-- DUPLICATION PROBE A: the chart-typed compatibility implies the new bare one. -/
theorem probe_chart_compat_to_loc (h : AwayCompatDivEq S E T) :
    AwayCompatPullDivEq S (fun i => (E i).eqns) T := by
  intro i j
  exact ⟨(E i).adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (T i j)
      (E i).certified.projective_colength,
    (E j).adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (T i j)
      (E j).certified.projective_colength,
    h i j⟩

/-- DUPLICATION PROBE B: the chart-typed glued system IS the new bare one at `(E i).eqns`
— on the nose. -/
theorem probe_glue_eq (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) (h : AwayCompatDivEq S E T) :
    awayGluedEquations g S E T hg h
      = awayGluedEquationsLoc g S (fun i => (E i).eqns) T hg
          (probe_chart_compat_to_loc g S E T h) := rfl

end
end AlgebraicGeometry

When you weaken a signature to bare data and carry a former side condition (`hreg`, `hproj`, an affineness witness) as an explicit hypothesis, you must decide between `∀ h, P h` and `∃ h, P h`.
